findings.title: A partly built EQL asset set is treated as complete by every later run
findings.label: valid
findings.note: eqlAssets returns needed=false as soon as the eql-<v> tag exists, without checking for docs or image, so once eql-sql has succeeded a failed eql-docs/eql-image (e.g. GHCR access, listed as outstanding in AGENTS.md) is never repaired by later pushes.

findings.title: Failed-publish recovery depends on unverified changesets/action behaviour and may fail every push to main
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Recovery depends on changesets/action setting publishedPackages and pushing tags when the publish command fails, which is unverified (tests inject it); otherwise eqlAssets throws on every production push.

findings.title: Wait passes but changeset publish still sees a stale npm packument and fails with E402
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculative registry-cache inconsistency after the wait succeeds; the E402 risk pre-existed and nothing in the cited code shows the change causes it.
